sections.title: CENTRAL GULF COAST AND LOWER MS VALLEY
sections.text: THE CENTER OF TS ISAAC IS OVER CENTRAL LA AND LATEST NHC FORECAST INDICATES THE REMNANT LOW PRESSURE SYSTEM WILL MOVE NNWWD REACHING WEST CENTRAL AR BY LATER TONIGHT. ALTHOUGH THE SYSTEM WILL CONTINUE TO WEAKEN AS IT MOVES FARTHER INLAND...LATEST AREA RAOBS AND VAD WIND PROFILES SHOW 45-55 KT WINDS IN THE LOWEST 1-2 KM RESULTING IN STRONG LOW LEVEL SHEAR AND SRH /30-40 KT SHEAR AND 150-300 M2/S2 SRH/. THIS WILL SUPPORT DEVELOPMENT OF SMALL EMBEDDED SUPERCELLS WITHIN CONVECTIVE BANDS OVER THE ERN SEMI-CIRCLE OF THE CIRCULATION. RADAR CURRENTLY SHOWS THREE DISTINCT BANDS OVER PARTS OF SRN MS EWD TO NEAR THE MS/AL BORDER...WITH STRONGER REFLECTIVITY AND SOME CG LIGHTNING EVIDENT IN THE TWO ERN-MOST BANDS OVER SERN MS AND ALONG THE BORDER. THIS SUGGESTS STRONGER UPDRAFT STRENGTH IN SOME CELLS DESPITE MODEST INSTABILITY /MLCAPE ESTIMATED AT 500-750 J PER KG/. OF PARTICULAR NOTE IS THE THINNING OF CLOUDS THAT IS OCCURRING BETWEEN THE CONVECTIVE BANDS OVER SERN MS THIS MORNING AS SEEN IN VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY. IF THIS TREND CONTINUES...ZONES OF ENHANCED DIABATIC HEATING AND DESTABILIZATION WILL OCCUR ADJACENT TO THE CONVECTION BANDS ENHANCING POTENTIAL FOR STRONGER CONVECTION THIS AFT

sections.title: LOWER CO RIVER VALLEY/SWRN AZ
sections.text: WATER VAPOR IMAGERY INDICATES A WEAK VORTICITY MAX APPROACHING EXTREME SWRN AZ. A SMALL AREA OF CONVECTION HAS DEVELOPED IN ASSOCIATION WITH THIS FEATURE. LIMITED CLOUDS TO THE NORTH AND NORTHEAST OF THE SYSTEM WILL ALLOW STRONG HEATING TO OCCUR TODAY...AND 12Z RAOBS AT YUM AND PHX SUGGEST THE AIR MASS WILL BECOME SUFFICIENTLY UNSTABLE TO SUPPORT ADDITIONAL THUNDERSTORM INITIATION. DEVELOPMENT OF A DEEP WELL-MIXED PBL AND PRESENCE OF SUBSTANTIAL DCAPE SUGGEST A FEW STORMS MAY PRODUCE STRONG DOWNBURST WINDS THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING. ..WEISS/GARNER.. 08/30/2012

sections.title: CNTRL GULF COAST/LOWER MS VALLEY
sections.text: PRIMARY CHANGE TO PREVIOUS FORECAST WAS TO SHIFT THE 10 PERCENT TORNADO PROBABILITY WWD TO S-CNTRL MS. ALTHOUGH TORNADO REPORTS HAVE YET TO MATERIALIZE SINCE 16Z AND CLOUD BREAKS WERE NO LONGER NOTED IN VIS IMAGERY...A DEVELOPING CONVECTIVE BAND WAS NOTED NEAR BTR TO JUST NW MCB. RECENT HRRR RUNS SUGGEST THIS BAND WILL INTENSIFY IN THE NEXT FEW HOURS...WITHIN THE LOW-LEVEL THERMAL RIDGE CHARACTERIZED BY UPPER 70S TO MIDDLE 80S SURFACE TEMPERATURES. IF UPDRAFTS DO MATURE WITHIN THIS CORRIDOR AND EVENTUALLY OVERLAP THE MORE INTENSE LOW-LEVEL SHEAR IN MS...THE TORNADO THREAT MAY INCREASE BEFORE DARK.

sections.title: LOWER CO RIVER VALLEY/SRN CA
sections.text: HAVE SHIFTED THE MARGINAL RISK FOR SEVERE WIND TOWARDS THE COASTAL MTNS OF SRN CA WHERE PRIMARY CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT HAS OCCURRED DOWNSTREAM OF A SUBTLE MID-LEVEL VORTICITY MAX. ALTHOUGH UPDRAFTS SHOULD REMAIN OF PULSE TYPE GIVEN THE WEAK DEEP-LAYER SHEAR...MODIFIED 19Z RAOB FROM YUM SUGGESTS AMPLE DCAPE EXISTS FOR LOCALIZED WET MICROBURSTS. ..GRAMS.. 08/30/2012 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1126 AM CDT THU AUG 30 2012/

mesoscale_discussions.summary: GREATEST TORNADO THREAT MAY BEGIN TO SHIFT WEST INTO ERN MS OVER THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS AS ISAAC DRIFTS INTO NWRN LA.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: REMNANTS OF ISAAC CONTINUE TO DRIFT WNWWD ACROSS NCNTRL LA WITH CENTER OF CIRCULATION NEAR THE CALDWELL/OUACHITA/JACKSON PARISH BORDER. OVER THE LAST FEW HOURS DISTINCT BREAKS IN CLOUD COVER HAVE DEVELOPED OVER ERN MS ALONG WRN FRINGE OF STRONGEST N-S CONVECTIVE BANDS. WHILE THE N-S CONVECTIVE BANDS HAVE STRUGGLED TO PROPAGATE WEST INTO THIS REGION NEW CONVECTION MAY ULTIMATELY EVOLVE OVER ERN MS WHERE ENHANCED BOUNDARY LAYER HEATING IS OCCURRING. EARLIER THIS MORNING MULTIPLE DISTINCT SUPERCELL STRUCTURES WERE EMBEDDED WITHIN THE N-S BAND ALONG THE MS/AL BORDER BUT THIS ACTIVITY HAS RECENTLY WANED IN INTENSITY. THERE IS REASON TO BELIEVE STRONGER SUPERCELL STRUCTURES WILL BEGIN TO SHIFT INTO THE AFOREMENTIONED CORRIDOR OF MS AS ISAAC SHIFTS WEST AND AIRMASS HEATS SLIGHTLY DUE TO BREAKS IN CLOUD COVER. ..DARROW.. 08/30/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE TORNADO THREAT WILL LIKELY PERSIST ACROSS THE AREA AS SHOWERS AND THUNDERSTORMS ASSOCIATED WITH TROPICAL DEPRESSION ISAAC CONTINUE TO IMPACT THE REGION.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AT 2350Z...THE WATCH AREA WAS LARGELY FREE OF SHOWERS AND TSTMS WITH THE EXCEPTION OF A FEW SHOWERS IN ERN MS. HOWEVER...A BAND OF SHOWERS AND TSTMS IS CURRENTLY MOVING ACROSS SE LA AND IS EXPECTED TO ENTER SRN MS SHORTLY. THE ENVIRONMENT ACROSS THE WATCH AREA CONTINUES TO BE CHARACTERIZED HIGH LOW-LEVEL SHEAR /0-1 KM SRH NEAR 300 M2/S2 AND 0-3 KM SRH ALSO AROUND 300 M2/S2/...WEAK INSTABILITY /MLCAPE AOB 250 J/KG/...AND MODEST LARGE-SCALE SHEAR /0-6 KM BULK SHEAR NEAR 40 KTS/. DRY AIR IS BEGINNING TO WORK INTO THE SERN QUADRANT OF ISAAC...APPARENT ON BOTH WV SATELLITE IMAGERY AND THE 00Z JAN SOUNDING...AND LIMITING THE EFFECTIVE INFLOW OF THE SHOWERS AND TSTMS. 23Z MESOANAYLSIS DEPICTS THIS WELL AS BOTH EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR AND EFFECTIVE SRH SHOW MINIMUMS IN ANALYZED VALUES ACROSS CNTRL MS. HOWEVER...GIVEN THE STRONG LOW-LEVEL SHEAR...A FEW STORMS WILL LIKELY EXHIBIT TRANSIENT ROTATION WITH THE POTENTIAL FOR A FEW SPIN UPS. ANY TORNADOES SHOULD BE SHORT-LIVED AS THE INFLOW QUICKLY WANES. AS DAYTIME HEATING CONTINUES TO DIMINISH AND DRY AIR CONTINUES TO WRAP AROUND THE SYSTEM...THE FREQUENCY AND INTENSITY OF THE INFLOW BANDS SHOULD WEAKEN. THIS IS EXPECTED TO LIMIT THE TORNADO THREAT ACROSS THE REGION AND AN EXTENSION OF THE TORNADO WATCH DOES NOT APPEAR LIKELY. HOWEVER...TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED CLOSELY AND THE DECISION WHETHER OR NOT TO EXTEND THE CURRENT WATCH WILL BE MADE CLOSER TO ITS EXPIRATION TIME AT 03Z. ..MOSIER.. 08/31/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE TORNADO THREAT ACROSS MS WILL LIKELY CONTINUE LATE THIS EVENING LASTING INTO THE OVERNIGHT PERIOD. A NEW TORNADO WATCH WILL NEED TO BE ISSUED PRIOR TO 03Z ACROSS PARTS OF MS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE CENTER OF TROPICAL DEPRESSION ISAAC IS LOCATED IN SRN AR WITH SEVERAL DISTINCT BUT VERY NARROW RAINBANDS EXTENDING SWD ACROSS MS. MESOANALYSIS SUGGESTS THE STRONGEST LOW-LEVEL FLOW IS PRESENT FROM ABOUT 100 STATUTE MILES NORTH OF ISAACS CENTER WRAPPING SEWD INTO NRN AND WRN MS ON THE NE QUADRANT OF ISAAC. REGIONAL WSR-88D VWPS ALONG WITH THE JACKSON 00Z SOUNDING SHOW 50 TO 55 KT OF FLOW IN THE 1 TO 3 KM LAYER WITH SOME BACKING NEAR THE SFC. THIS WIND PROFILE ALONG WITH SFC DEWPOINTS IN THE LOWER TO MID 70S F AND LCL HEIGHTS AROUND 500 METERS SHOULD BE FAVORABLE FOR LOW-CLOUD BASE ROTATION WITH POTENTIAL TO PRODUCE TORNADOES. THE TORNADO THREAT IS EXPECTED TO CONTINUE THROUGH THE OVERNIGHT PERIOD AND MAY GRADUALLY SHIFT NWD WITH TIME. ..BROYLES.. 08/31/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: VIGOROUS ONGOING STORM DEVELOPMENT ACROSS SOUTHWEST THROUGH CENTRAL LOUISIANA MAY PERSIST ANOTHER COUPLE OF HOURS...BEFORE BEGINNING TO DIMINISH BY 11-13Z. SEVERE WIND/ISOLATED TORNADO POTENTIAL APPEARS LOW...BUT MAY NOT BE COMPLETELY NEGLIGIBLE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A RELATIVELY DEEP LAYER...NEAR SURFACE CONFLUENCE ZONE TO THE SOUTH OF THE REMNANTS OF ISAAC HAS BEEN THE FOCUS FOR THE MOST VIGOROUS CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT DURING THE PAST FEW HOURS. ACTIVITY HAS BEEN SUPPORTED BY INFLOW OF MOISTURE CHARACTERIZED BY MID/UPPER 70S SURFACE DEW POINTS...WHICH MAY BE CONTRIBUTING TO AT LEAST MODEST CAPE. BENEATH THE MID/UPPER DRY SLOT TO THE SOUTH OF THE CIRCULATION CENTER OF ISAAC...NOW OVER WEST CENTRAL ARKANSAS...THERMODYNAMIC PROFILES HAVE BEEN CONDUCIVE TO THUNDERSTORM ACTIVITY WITH OCCASIONALLY FREQUENT CLOUD TO GROUND LIGHTNING STRIKES...IN ADDITION TO LOCALLY VERY HEAVY RAINFALL... LIKELY AT RATES WELL IN EXCESS OF 2 INCHES PER HOUR. AS THE SURFACE LOW CENTER ASSOCIATED WITH THE REMNANTS OF ISAAC CONTINUES TO SLOWLY DEVELOP NORTHWARD TOWARD THE FAYETTEVILLE/ HARRISON AREA...AND GRADUALLY WEAKEN...THROUGH 11-13Z...WEAKENING WIND FIELDS AND LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE ACROSS SOUTHWEST THROUGH CENTRAL LOUISIANA MAY RESULT IN DIMINISHING CONVECTIVE TRENDS.
